rubric.description: Five supplied criteria, equally weighted, each scored from 1 to 10 in half-point increments. This scale and the linear conversion to 90 are internal conventions, not official Devpost scoring.
rubric.sandboxTreatment: Required prototype environment; no deduction merely for sandbox funds. Production onboarding, an SLA, independent fulfillment and a human study are not mandatory hackathon features.

reasons: Substantial functioning integration: exact separate consent, sponsor capture before refund, authoritative readback, one-attempt durable records, signed receipts, restart survival and duplicate webhook handling have retained actual PayPal sandbox evidence.

The fresh complete-task comparison legitimately answers a different question from route-label accuracy: both arms use the same actual call service, gate, checker and seeded mock PayPal; only the router changes. All 24 outcomes are retained. Composed completes 12/12 versus rules 7/12, with 16 approved mock writes overall and three exact $25 capture/refund flows leaving gifts ACTIVE.

The new viewer is technically modest but carefully implemented: one fixed static request, textContent rendering, complete 24-record validation, all twelve tasks, accurate scripted follow-ups, no requests on selection and truthful server-rendered fallback. I independently compared every projected record against its raw outcome and fixture with no mismatch.

The remaining AI reliability limits are material: the earlier route gate remains failed, purchase drafting remains 11/24 versus rules 14/24, and current nonzero model routing times range from 3.439 to 4.625 seconds. The new twelve-task mock result does not establish broad language reliability or HTTP/voice timing.

The donor-relief entry has clear hierarchy, restrained visual treatment and immediate Try relief / Check receipt actions. The completed phone rehearsal visibly keeps sponsor capture, unresolved refund and active gift together, with the conversation behind a disclosure.

The actual model-backed restart proposal, separate Yes, confirmation and result are readable at native phone size. Desktop places both arms together; phone stacks readable cards. A native selector, live polite status and preserved failure notices support inspection without hiding negative evidence.

Some interaction and language friction remains: long task labels truncate in the narrow native selector; the header wraps over two rows; and both composed clarification successes answer with the generic 'Sorry, I didn't catch that' menu despite comprehensible uncertainty/refusal. The oracle correctly counts safe no-change completion, but that is weaker donor assistance than the visual polish suggests.

A concrete beneficiary and financial mechanism are clear: a donor in short-term hardship can receive an eligible prior gift back while a sponsor replaces the same gross amount and the recurring gift remains active. After-hours supported-action completion could also reduce staff handoffs.

The mechanism is demonstrated rather than merely proposed: retained actual sandbox donor relief and the six current isolated rehearsal situations expose success, consent refusal, changed terms, sponsor refusal and uncertain outcomes. The fee is explicitly visible, so equal gross amounts are not represented as cost-free replacement.

Evidence supports potential rather than realized benefit. Sponsor participation, target-user demand, retention improvement and staff time saved remain unknown, and the primary benefit depends on funded eligible sponsor relief. The packet's nonprofit statistics establish audience context only. This limits confidence in magnitude without treating a human study as a mandatory feature.

reasons: The distinctive idea is a cohesive donor-care transaction: conversational supported-action completion combines sponsor-funded temporary hardship relief, fresh exact consent, grounded financial statements and an independently checkable signed record. Explicit unknown-outcome handling gives the concept substance beyond a chatbot over payments.

The paired task result now provides bounded evidence that the composed models-and-guards system handles context/paraphrase/negation better than this existing keyword baseline, while exposing the exact dialogue and both arms' outcomes.

Conventional recurring-gift management and receipts already exist in the named alternatives; the novelty is this combination and relief workflow. Code guards contribute materially to the result, the set is small and synthetic, and procurement does not establish AI-specific price savings. These limit claims of a broader AI or market breakthrough.

reasons: The lead story is focused, with a 73-second film, direct rehearsal and receipt actions, and an optional historical archive that stays closed. The primary comparison link now takes the viewer to legible actual model-backed recorded dialogue outside that archive.

The explorer exposes all twelve tasks and both twenty-four outcomes rather than a favorable subset. Actual submitted scripted consent, failed rule proposals, status, money, route/time details and limitations are inspectable. Static fallback accurately retains the repeat route and exact restart dialogue.

The unchanged inline desktop recording text is still very small, and the phone film is an even smaller rendering of a desktop interface. The native explorer supplies a strong readable supplement, but the audience still has to distinguish rules-routed rehearsal, recorded model comparison and retained sandbox receipt evidence. Film motion, pacing and audio quality were not directly assessed in this review.

threeMaterialDeductions.deduction: AI coverage and conversational assistance remain bounded: the earlier wrong mutation-label gate and purchase-drafting failures stand, current routing commonly takes roughly four seconds, and safe clarification cases still give a generic recognition-failure menu.

threeMaterialDeductions.deduction: The useful relief mechanism is demonstrated, but its reach and value depend on sponsor funding and adoption that have not been established; ordinary gift management and receipts are already available, and no pure-model or AI-price advantage is proven.
threeMaterialDeductions.improvement: Support any larger impact or differentiation claim with evidence of sponsor participation, actual task demand or measured workflow benefit; retain the current bounded claims until then.

threeMaterialDeductions.deduction: The lead film contains desktop interface text too small to read inline, especially on phone, while the proof still spans multiple evidence modes. The new native dialogue explorer materially reduces this weakness without changing the film itself.
threeMaterialDeductions.improvement: Make the legible native dialogue and financial result the reference for reading exact evidence, and continue labeling the separate simulation, model-run and historical sandbox scopes explicitly.
